setting: Speech decoding from intracranial recordings in humans (ECoG, sEEG, intracortical), as in the published intracranial topic populations; usual approach counted among studies first public before 2010-11 (more than six months before the target); 2010-11 to 2011-11 is [concurrent]. Novelty is checked against any signal by a whole-wiki full-text pattern, as published reviews do.

M01.lineage: Guenther et al. 2009, same participant: cued attempted speech

M04.lineage: Guenther et al. 2009 / Brumberg et al. 2009: attempted speech by the same locked-in participant

M05.lineage: Kennedy Neurotrophic Electrode, same implant as Guenther et al. 2009

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule (intracranial signal named with phonemes, vowels, consonants or syllables in the ledger text; design = size of the speech-unit class set, full inventory versus a subset of two to six units). For this target the usual approach is judged on studies first public before 2010-11; [concurrent] 2010-11 to 2011-11. Novelty across signals: whole-wiki full-text pattern for full phone or phoneme sets (38-46 phonemes or phones, all phonemes, phoneme inventory), prior hits read as snippets. Boundary: reviews and mapping studies stay in the population; version duplicates merged.

M11.note: labels are the cued stimulus plus post-trial self-report; no attempt onset; no audit (M11 gives no field-practice count)

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule (intracranial speech decoding; design = how test data are separated from training data). For this target the published design regexes are applied to the unique ledger-pattern studies first public before 2010-11 (12 studies after merging versions); online closed-loop testing added as a design. Boundary: mentions count (upper bound); target and duplicates excluded.
